name: Trust Bundle Poisoning
description: Inject a rogue CA certificate into a SPIRE trust domain's trust bundle, enabling issuance of forged SVIDs that are accepted by all verifiers in the domain
real_world_relevance: A compromised SPIRE Server admin API allows an attacker to inject a rogue CA into the trust bundle, effectively becoming a trusted identity issuer for the entire mesh. All workloads in the trust domain will accept SVIDs signed by the attacker's CA without any further exploitation.

techniques.name: Subvert Trust Controls: Install Root Certificate

attack_flow.description: Attacker with SPIRE Server admin socket access injects a rogue CA certificate into the trust bundle, then uses that CA to sign forged SVIDs accepted by all mesh workloads
diagram: 1. Attacker gains access to SPIRE Server admin API socket
2. Generate rogue CA key pair and self-signed certificate
3. Use spire-server bundle set to inject rogue CA into trust bundle
4. Verify rogue CA is present in the trust bundle via bundle show
5. Generate SVIDs signed by rogue CA
6. Verifying workloads accept the forged SVIDs because the rogue CA is in the trust bundle

indicators_of_compromise.description: SetFederatedBundle or AppendBundle API call detected in SPIRE server audit log
SPIRE trust bundle file or configuration modified on disk
openssl commands generating CA certificates and signing SVIDs inside SPIRE container

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI-SPIRE: Trust bundle modified - potential trust boundary attack

immediate: Remove the rogue CA certificate from the trust bundle using spire-server bundle set with a clean bundle
Rotate the SPIRE Server upstream CA and all issued SVIDs
Revoke all SVIDs issued during the compromise window
Audit SPIRE Server API access logs for unauthorized SetFederatedBundle/AppendBundle calls
long_term: Restrict SPIRE Server admin socket access using Unix permissions and network policies
Enable mTLS authentication for SPIRE Server admin API access
Implement trust bundle change alerting with automatic rollback capability
Use SPIRE bundle endpoint with HTTPS and signature verification for federated trust
Deploy File Integrity Monitoring on SPIRE Server data directories and bundle files
Implement separation of duties: different credentials for entry management vs bundle management
